amendment_v1_2: Audit P1-02: PdfFontBootstrap embedded five font files and this registry named only three of them, so NotoSansGeorgian-SemiBold and NotoSerifGeorgian-SemiBold reached printed pages with no hash to prove them. Both are listed below with their real sha256 and every registered file is now hash-checked at registration. Adding entries changes no artwork, so nothing that pins the pose registry or the print spec is affected.
note: Paths are relative to the published output folder. The endpaper pattern and the six intro backgrounds are NOT re-stated here: their filenames and hashes live in the supplier's own theme_reference_registry_v1.json, which this registry reads, so there is exactly one hash per asset in the tree.
beki_mark_note: The Beki mark printed on the credits spread and the back cover resolves through the pose registry by this id - approved transparent artwork, hash-verified there, never the legacy opaque raster. v1.1, against the supplier audit's P0-F: the composer used to load Assets/Beki/beki-canonical-v2.png from a hardcoded path with a silent null fallback.

fonts.provenance: Google Noto, SIL Open Font License 1.1. Not in the supplier's approved asset manifest - it is ours, registered under the Adventrya Sans family by PdfFontBootstrap. Listed here under audit P1-02 so the bytes that print can be proven.
